texts.preamble: Binu Balachandran vs Arun Prakash on 10 June, 2025 Author: Devan Ramachandran Bench: Devan Ramachandran 2025:Ker:40839 In The High Court Of Kerala At Ernakulam Present The Honourable Mr. Justice Devan Ramachandran & The Honourable Mrs. Justice M.B. Snehalatha Tuesday, The 10Th Day Of June 2025 / 20Th Jyaishta, 1947 Op (Fc) No. 328 Of 2025 Against The Order Dated 12.05.2025 In Ia No.6 Of 2025 Of Family Court,Thrissur Arising Out Of The Order In Gop No.642 Of 2024 Of Family Court,Thrissur Petitioner/Petitioner/Respondent: Binu Balachandran, Aged 34 Years D/O. Balachandran, Thoppilkalam House, Kalleppadam.P.O, Pazhayannur, Thrissur District, Pin - 680587 By Adv Sri.K.M.Muhammed Hussain Respondent/Respondent/Petitioner: Arun Prakash, Aged 40 Years S/O. Prakash, Valiyaparambil House, Thrikkakkara North Village, Vattekunnam, Kanayannur Taluk, Ernakulam,, Pin - 682024 By Advs. Shri.E.C.Ahamed Fazil Sri.M.H.Salim This Op (Family Court) Having Come Up For Admission On 10.06.2025, The Court On The Same Day Delivered The Following: 2025:Ker:40839 Op(Fc) 328/25 2 Judgment
texts.arguments: .K.M.Muhammed Hussain - learned counsel for the petitioner, submitted that the orders of the learned Family Court, to allow the children to be taken out of the Court premises during the time when the respondent-father has been given their interim custody, is illegal and unlawful because, the past experiences show that he has not taken care of them in a manner as a father should. 7. In Indu (supra), which was followed by a further judgment of ours reported as Plessy Francis v. Dinto Mathews [2025 KHC Online 517] we have ordered that no Family Court shall ordinarily allow the exchange of children either in its premises or involving Police Stations.
texts.petitioner_arguments: .K.M.Muhammed Hussain - learned counsel for the petitioner, submitted that the orders of the learned Family Court, to allow the children to be taken out of the Court premises during the time when the respondent-father has been given their interim custody, is illegal and unlawful because, the past experiences show that he has not taken care of them in a manner as a father should.
